Header: page number at top left, running head at top right. The text is one continuous paragraph running on from the previous page.

main_text.p: cesimo ostavo quoquo die, accipiendo Mensem pro quatuor septimanarum spa-cio,quæ est una ejus nominis significatio; ille contrà non deberi diceret ante ulti-mum diem Ianuarii, & sic deinceps, accipiendo Mensem pro duodecima fere anni parte ut in Calendario in-duodecim menses totus annus distribu-itur, quæ est ejusdem vocis altera sig-nificatio: æquissimum est, ut vox am-bigua ex ipsius potius quàm illorum mente accipiatur. Quia illa pensio non est eis debita ex justitia, & ante fa-ctam promissionem; sed ex charitate, & vi promissionis liberæ, non alicujus pa-ctionis aut contractus. Et de hoc genere juramenti debent illa verba intelligi, quæ citantur in glossa Iuris Canonici, {a} Patetgloss. ad c.22. qu.5. c.11. quod Deus non accipit sic juramentum, sicut ille cui juratur, sed potiùs sicut qui jurat intelligit. Sed ut hæc responsio re-ctius intelligatur, duo sunt observanda. Alterum, quòd hoc in spontaneis jura-mentis & promissionibus potissimum ob-tinet, cùm τ ἐπιεικῶν[?] diversa fit ratio, ut mox dicetur. Alterum, jurantem in præ-senti casu obligari ad promissum servan-dum eo sensu, quem ipse verbis suis, quo tempore juravit, aut bona fide intende-bat,

page.notes: Fragment at the start: the page begins mid-word ("cesimo"); the first word is the end of "vicesimo" or similar, and is kept as a fragment. Long s is written as plain s throughout, so "ostavo", "Mensem", "spa-cio" etc. are normalised. The Greek "τ ἐπιεικῶν" is hard to read; the first letter and the accents are doubtful. The gloss note is printed beside the line area of "Patet" and its reference mark is "a". Right-margin fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted. Lines carry no printed indent, so the page is one paragraph.
